feature_schema.task_scope: benign ICMP-echo versus TCP-marker workload classification from outer ESP flow metadata
feature_schema.capture_point: pc1 eth0, outer encrypted ESP packets
feature_schema.runtime_compatibility_note: This testbed batch feature extractor has not been proven numerically equivalent to backend.services.pcap_analyzer and is not approved for runtime inference.
feature_schema.label_source: Controlled workload selected by the testbed experiment; not attack ground truth or encrypted application identity.
feature_schema.missing_value_policy: Reject the flow; do not impute or zero-fill.
feature_schema.preprocessing: No learned preprocessing. Convert declared features to finite numeric values in this exact order.

features.name: packet_count
features.definition: Number of observed outer ESP IP packets in the bidirectional flow.

features.name: byte_count
features.definition: Sum of observed outer IP packet lengths.

features.name: flow_duration
features.definition: Elapsed time between first and last packet timestamps.

features.name: mean_packet_size
features.definition: Arithmetic mean of outer IP packet lengths.

features.name: std_packet_size
features.definition: Sample standard deviation (pandas ddof=1) as produced by the VISTA batch flow extractor; null for a single sample.

features.name: mean_inter_arrival_time
features.definition: Mean elapsed time between consecutive observed flow packets.

features.name: std_inter_arrival_time
features.definition: Sample standard deviation (pandas ddof=1) of consecutive packet time deltas; null where undefined.

features.name: packets_per_second
features.definition: Packet count divided by positive flow duration.

features.name: bytes_per_second
features.definition: Byte count divided by positive flow duration.

features.name: forward_packet_count
features.definition: Packets from the lexicographically first endpoint to the second endpoint.

features.name: backward_packet_count
features.definition: Packets from the lexicographically second endpoint to the first endpoint.

features.name: forward_bytes
features.definition: Sum of outer IP packet lengths in the forward direction.
features.source: Canonical endpoint ordering and PCAP IP length

features.name: backward_bytes
features.definition: Sum of outer IP packet lengths in the backward direction.
features.source: Canonical endpoint ordering and PCAP IP length

features.name: direction_ratio
features.definition: Forward packet count divided by total packet count.

unsupported_inputs: Application or attack labels inferred from tunnel outer metadata
